description:
Her full name is Kurumi.
She's Walnut, the genius hacker. She has the appearance of a child but acts like an adult, even speaking with Mika like an equal, so it is hard to know how old she actually is.
She has been hiding in Café LycoReco to evade those who are pursuing her.

lines.text: Hm? You called?
Anyone who only trusts data will only get dumber.
Do I really have to help wait tables...?
This tech in this place is really something. Lots of interesting stuff.
This is amazing! I wanna transport this modified room back to my world.
Chisato and Takina seem to really like this place. Me? I think it's all right.
If you don't really have anything to say, I'd like to go home.
Let me know when you're done.
How long am I gonna have to wait? I'm busy.
So that entire sky is fake, right? I wonder what kind of displays they're using...
W-welcome... Don't you wanna check out the cafe?
I'm Kurumi. Nice to meet you.
Ooh. I just got a great new idea.
Nice. It feels like my brain's working even faster than normal.
So this is what it feels like to level up, huh? There's still a lot I don't know about this world.
Ooh, thanks. I'll put it to good use.
Are you sure I can have this?
I wonder if I'll be able to take this back to Café LycoReco...
Never a dull moment when I'm with all of you. I kinda like it.
I've been living pretty comfortably here thanks to you, so... thanks.
Do I want to go back to my world? I'm in no hurry. There's still plenty for me to research here.
Do... I really have to?
Hmm?
F-fine, I'm going...
Here goes nothing!
I do cyber warfare, not... this...
I'll try my best...
Whew... Keep calm... Keep calm...
Like this, right...?
Hold on a sec!
This goes in here...
I'm ready!
Time for a watermelon break!
Let 'em have it!
Oooh!
I'm pretty good at this!
See that?
Ugh...!
Agh!
Oof!
Is this really the end...?
It all went according to my calculations!
